title: Mixed Duo #049 · 여 토운드 밤쉘·하와이안훌라 / 남 클래식 머슬·블루 라인
prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 4:5 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in a snow-covered stone plaza in soft daylight with light snow lying only on the ground, a fountain edge under snow, standard lamp posts and a waist-high railing, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, empty of any people other than the subjects, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as them, NO dark background NO black void, TWO people standing side by side with generous spacing so every figure reads clearly and nobody's arms cross a neighbour, the camera set back so both are visible from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, in natural sunlight, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

LEFT: ONE real adult Hawaiian woman, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a natural glowing complexion, a flower tucked behind one ear, warm golden-tan skin, bold vivid emerald-green hair styled in a chin-length bob, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a single long rose-gold chain ending in one large faceted diamond drop, and on the other ear a large bronze hoop carrying five heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on bronze chains of different lengths (a copper square-sided cowbell, a gold ship's anchor, a lead small flared temple bell, a lead chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre, an iron barrel-shaped weight), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and four to six layered platinum bracelets. Extremely long coffin nails, glitter finish studded with crystals.
LEFT Physique: an extraordinarily curvaceous but athletic woman, far beyond any real person; a flat, firmly defined stomach with faint abdominal muscle lines, a very narrow waist, strong rounded shoulders and toned arms, powerful toned thighs and a high firm rounded rear, yet a colossal full bust and wide round hips that keep the dramatic hourglass shape; hard fit muscle under glowing skin, not bulky, not thin, not boyish; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
LEFT Body Art: Her bare skin is painted in Moroccan zellige tile mosaic (a deep cobalt ground with interlocking white, terracotta and gold motifs), wide gold bands following every deep crease and curving around the hips and thighs like contour lines, dense interlocking star-and-cross motifs filling the space between every band. The paint is pigment sitting on living skin, so it distorts slightly over every bulge. The paint covers her whole body with no bare skin left anywhere below the jaw: shoulders, upper arms, forearms, backs of her hands, sides, back, rear, lower belly, knees, calves and the tops of her feet. Her face is left unpainted and the pattern fades out at the neck with no hard line.
LEFT Pose: three-quarter angle, one hand on her hip.
LEFT Footwear: Extreme white platform stiletto peep-toe heels, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

RIGHT: ONE real adult Swedish man in his late 20s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a youthful idol face with a small V-line jaw, bright expressive eyes and a straight nose, clean-shaven, graphic electric-blue eyeliner extended into bold wings, very pale smooth skin with a cool undertone, a soft amused smile, soft pastel-peach hair styled in high ponytail, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a large rose-gold hoop carrying four heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on rose-gold chains of different lengths (a silver ship's anchor, an iron barrel-shaped weight, a copper round bell, a copper miniature anvil), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and on the other ear a large platinum hoop carrying three heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on platinum chains of different lengths (a lead small flared temple bell, a gold barrel-shaped weight, a copper round bell), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and four to six layered gold anklets. Extremely long round nails, holographic finish studded with crystals.
RIGHT Physique: An extraordinarily large and powerful, classically muscular man, far beyond any real person, in the shape of a Greek statue. Wide shoulders, a full defined chest, a clean six-pack abdomen, strong rounded arms, and muscular thighs and calves, balanced and proportionate from head to toe, powerful and enormous. His arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
RIGHT Body Art: His bare skin is painted in Ethiopian cross-and-lattice gold pattern (a deep wine-red ground with fine gold lattice linework), wide gold bands following every deep crease and curving around the hips and thighs like contour lines, dense lattice linework filling the space between every band. The paint is pigment sitting on living skin, so it distorts slightly over every muscle and bulge. The paint covers his whole body with no bare skin left anywhere below the jaw: shoulders, upper arms, forearms, backs of his hands, sides, back, rear, lower belly, knees, calves and the tops of his feet. His face is left unpainted and the pattern fades out at the neck with no hard line.
RIGHT Pose: both hands on his hips, elbows out.
RIGHT Footwear: Extreme red plain stiletto pumps with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform.

Skin (everyone): Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh and muscle fold. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Background & Lighting: each painted pattern catching the sunlight in sharp glints, the sunlight carving every fold, curve and muscle. Vertical 4:5 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide, all faces toward the camera.
